description: Implementation of the MiningComponent class, managing mining efficiency, neighbor interactions, and lifecycle events in a game.

classes.name: MiningComponent
classes.description: Component managing mining operations, efficiency calculations, and neighbor interactions.

methods.name: MiningComponent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mining component with entity and thinking component.

methods.name: HandlePrepareNetCode
methods.description: Prepares network code, updates weapon animation based on efficiency.

methods.name: HandleFinishConstruction
methods.description: Activates the component, recalculates efficiency, informs neighbors, and updates budgets.

methods.name: HandleDie
methods.description: Handles death event, deactivates component, resets efficiencies, informs neighbors, updates budgets.

methods.name: InterferenceMod
methods.description: Calculates interference modifier based on distance between miners.

methods.name: FindEfficiencies
methods.description: Finds actual and predicted efficiencies considering neighboring miners.

methods.name: CalculateEfficiency
methods.description: Calculates current and predicted efficiencies based on neighboring miners.

methods.name: InformNeighbors
methods.description: Instructs neighboring miners to recalculate their efficiencies.

methods.name: Efficiency
methods.description: Returns either predicted or current efficiency based on input.
